visualizations.description: Algorithms learning app — orbitals are individual computer-science algorithms, each composed via `uses` from a per-algorithm engine atom on algorithm-canvas (bars/cells) or biology-canvas (graphs).

Astronomy lab organism — a Kepler orbit simulator (drag eccentricity/semi-major axis, step the planet, watch equal-area sweeps), a star life-cycle stepper (pick a starting mass, step from nebula to white dwarf / neutron star / black hole), and a 3D solar-system orbital instrument (inner planets, Pluto's 17° inclination, Halley's eccentric comet), composed from the std-astro-orbit, std-astro-stellar, and std-astro-orbit-3d instrument atoms behind a mode router.
Biology learning app — a fat organism whose orbitals are individual biology topics, each composed via `uses` from a per-topic engine atom on the biology-canvas.
Chemistry learning app — a fat organism whose orbitals are individual chemistry topics, each composed via `uses` from a per-topic engine atom on the chemistry-canvas.

Civics lab organism — how a bill becomes law (a bill token travels Introduced -> House vote -> Senate vote -> President, with veto and a two-thirds override) and a checks-and-balances matrix (learner names which branch can check a given action, drawing the check arrow on a three-branch diagram), composed from the std-civics-billprocess and std-civics-checks instrument atoms behind a mode router.

Earth-science lab organism — a plate-tectonics boundary simulator (learner picks convergent/divergent/transform and drives the motion), a 3D plate-tectonics cross-section explorer (rotatable block-section through a subduction zone with boundary presets and a narrated tour), and an interactive water-cycle flux simulator (learner drives solar input and steps the cycle), composed from the std-earth-plates, std-earth-plates-3d, and std-earth-watercycle instrument atoms behind a mode router.

Economics lab organism — a supply-and-demand market simulator (learner shifts demand/supply curves and sets a price to see surplus or shortage) and a production-possibilities frontier simulator (learner allocates resources between two goods and sees opportunity cost, with an inefficiency demo), composed from the std-econ-market and std-econ-ppf instrument atoms behind a mode router.

Geography lab organism — an age-sex population pyramid simulator (learner drives birth/death/migration rate dials and steps a cohort-component projection across five age bands), a simplified Köppen climate classifier (learner sets a summer/winter temperature and precipitation profile and a 12-month climograph classifies it), and a 3D digital terrain model instrument (procedural ridgeline/valley/basin terrains with elevation-colored samples, a flood knob, and a click readout of elevation, slope, and contour band), composed from the std-geo-population, std-geo-koppen, and std-geo-dtm-3d instrument atoms behind a mode router.

History lab organism — a WWI causal-chain counterfactual (toggle structural causes and triggers off/on and watch whether war still breaks out) and a Fall-of-Rome periodization timeline (step through events and filter by political/military/economic lens), composed from the std-hist-causalchain and std-learn-stepper instrument atoms behind a mode router.

Linguistics lab organism — a Universal Grammar syntax-tree builder (learner assembles a sentence's constituent structure bottom-up, one labelled bracket at a time) and a historical sound-change stepper (learner applies ordered Great Vowel Shift rules and watches every matching word's pronunciation shift at once), composed from the std-ling-syntaxtree and std-ling-soundchange instrument atoms behind a mode router.

Propositional logic lab organism — toggle atomic proposition truth values and watch compound formulas evaluate live on a truth table, apply inference rules (modus ponens, modus tollens) step by step in a guided proof, test syllogisms on a Venn diagram, propagate values through a boolean circuit, classify arguments as valid or fallacious, or evaluate quantified statements against a finite model, composed from the std-logic-truthtable, std-logic-inference, std-logic-venn, std-logic-gates, std-logic-fallacy, and std-logic-quantifier instrument atoms behind a mode router.
Math learning app — a fat organism whose orbitals are individual math topics, each composed via `uses` from a per-topic engine atom on the math-canvas.
Physics learning app — a fat organism whose orbitals are individual physics topics, each composed via `uses` from a per-law engine atom. kflow presents one orbital as one lesson.
Probability learning app — a fat organism whose orbitals are individual probability topics, each composed via `uses` from a per-topic engine atom on the physics/math canvas.

Psychology lab organism — a classical (Pavlovian) conditioning trial-runner where the learner drives a Rescorla-Wagner acquisition/extinction curve, and a Maslow's-hierarchy-of-needs classifier where the learner sorts everyday scenarios onto a 5-tier needs pyramid, composed from the std-psych-conditioning and std-learn-classify instrument atoms behind a mode router.

Sociology lab organism — a social-stratification & mobility simulator (5 class strata redistribute across generations as the learner drives a mobility index) and a Sociological Imagination exercise (Mills: link each personal trouble to the public issue behind it), composed from the std-soc-stratification and std-soc-imagination instrument atoms behind a mode router.
